title: HITMAN
provenance: Reported by HaxproLegend (highball-db#1267, 2026-11-16), Apple M5, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 31 minutes: named HITMAN in the report with no Steam id, so taken by its name to be the 2016 HITMAN (236870), not HITMAN World of Assassination (1659040). A full mission on default settings, smooth. Not verified by the maintainer. HaxproLegend on highball-db#1267 (2026-11-18): the copy is the Epic one, and it only has the first part, not the full World of Assassination.
notes: IO Interactive's 2016 HITMAN. Reported perfect on an M5 with DXMT on the default engine (r28), a full mission on default settings over 31 minutes. The player's copy is the Epic one, which has the first part only, not the full HITMAN World of Assassination (1659040), which has no page yet (highball-db#1267). Steam lists a Mac version as well.
